scope: Potential Operations and Approved Operations existing views only
finding: The current Potential Operations route renders rows from retained analytical projections, while manual proposals are represented only by the new isolated workflow store. No authoritative proposal-id mapping, persistent manual-store location, CSRF/action endpoint, or central membership-commit adapter is wired into this web surface.
why_blocked: Adding Validate/Promote controls now would either be inert or would require selecting a production proposal store and membership-commit authority not established by the manual-workflow qualification. Either would exceed the requested minimal UI exposure.
required_next_authorization: Choose/authorize the non-authoritative persistent proposal store and central manual-promotion membership adapter, then wire narrow POST endpoints with existing CSRF/confirmation conventions.
